PC8-266 - Core Development Services/Verizon Wireless A request for a Special Use Permit (height) to allow for a 50 foot high Verizon Wireless faux eucalyptus tree cellular communications tower and associated equipment enclosures near an existing industrial building located at 450 West California Avenue.
2.
PC20-123 - City of Vista A request to amend Chapters 18.31, 18.34 and 18.35 of the Vista Development Code to repeal inclusionary housing requirements and affordable housing covenants for second units. This project has been determined to be exempt from environmental review under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) in accordance with Section 15061 of the CEQA Guidelines.
